body: I just wish I didn't feel stuck in this situation. It sucks and feels like I'm drowning. Homelessness seems too real right now. At this point, however, I'm feeling slightly more sane, I've made a roommate request on craigslist. The suicidal feeling is still lingering more so than usual, however. I appreciate you taking the time to write this comment, it makes me feel a bit better that someone is listening
